name: @texuli/mcp

tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Search the built, content-addressed Texuli component catalog by text, group and emit tier. Returns the catalog hash and file name, the match count and one summary per component (id, package, label, summary, tier, group, emit tiers). Limits: input up to 4096 bytes, at most 100 items, 5000 ms budget.

query.description: Text to match against component ids, labels and summaries.

group.description: An exact manifest group id, e.g. "display" or "forms".

tier.description: Keep only components this emit tier may place: untrusted is what agent output may use; developer is app-authored code.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 100, default 50).

tools.name: catalog.validate
tools.description: Validate one candidate catalog manifest, or a set (which also catches duplicate ids), without writing files. Returns valid and a list of diagnostics, each with a code, a JSONPath, a message and a hint. Limits: input up to 1000000 bytes, at most 500 items, 5000 ms budget.

manifest.description: A candidate catalog manifest (id, package, label, summary, tier, props, examples …).

items.description: A candidate catalog manifest (id, package, label, summary, tier, props, examples …).

inputSchema.$comment: Exactly one of manifest or manifests.

tools.name: component.get
tools.description: Read one component manifest from the catalog by id. Returns { component }: its props with kinds and schemas, events, worked examples, useWhen and dontUseWhen guidance, accessibility notes and the emit tiers that may place it (an empty emit list means agent output may not). Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

id.description: A catalog component id, e.g. "card" (find ids with catalog.search).

tools.name: example.search
tools.description: Find worked manifest examples (props an agent can copy) by component id and/or example id, or search their titles and descriptions. Returns the match count and each example with its component id and package. Limits: input up to 4096 bytes, at most 100 items, 5000 ms budget.

componentId.description: A catalog component id, e.g. "card" (find ids with catalog.search).

exampleId.description: An exact example id within the component, e.g. "basic".

query.description: Text to match against example ids, titles and descriptions.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 100, default 50).

tools.name: blueprint.validate
tools.description: Validate a blueprint draft (a catalog tree, an array of trees, or a texuli-blueprint envelope, migrated first) with the catalog's checks: structure, sinks, tree limits, component ids, tiers, prop, block and document schemas, the envelope's designSystem (codes under $.designSystem), grammar and the frame root. Returns valid, status, tier, migratedFrom and diagnostics with stable codes. Limits: input up to 270336 bytes, at most 512 items, 5000 ms budget.

draft.description: The blueprint: a catalog tree { id, props, children }, an array of trees, or a texuli-blueprint envelope (format, version, id, catalog hash from catalog.search, status, createdAt, updatedAt, generator, tree). At most 512 nodes. schema-form, canvas and spreadsheet nodes and data-source bindings are refused: this server has no validator for them.

tier.description: The tier to validate at: untrusted (agent output, the default) or developer (app-authored). A tier the draft declares is ignored.

fragment.description: Accept any roots (a fragment). Default false: one frame root (layout-page, layout-doc, layout-deck, document, canvas or data-dashboard).

tools.name: blueprint.theme
tools.description: Set a blueprint envelope's designSystem to a reference ({ ref: "acme@2.1.0" } or a library theme "texuli:ocean") or an inline document, wrapping a bare tree in a draft envelope first, then validate the result as blueprint.validate does; an inline document is also compiled for the contrast, focus and target guarantees. Returns valid, the themed blueprint and diagnostics with stable codes. Limits: input up to 1318912 bytes, at most 512 items, 10000 ms budget.

blueprint.description: A texuli-blueprint envelope, or a catalog tree (or array of trees) to wrap in a draft envelope for the current catalog.

ref.description: An exact id@x.y.z the host resolves, or texuli:<theme> for a library theme; never a range, URL or path.

inline.description: A whole design-system document carried in the blueprint.

designSystem.description: Exactly one of ref and inline.

tier.description: The tier to validate at: untrusted (agent output, the default; refuses data: URLs in an inline document) or developer.

id.description: A wrapped tree only: the envelope id (default "draft").

tools.name: block.list
tools.description: List the content block types the blocks-* components render (table, stat, cta, poll …), optionally for one component or matching words. Returns the match count and, per type, the component that renders it, a label and when to use it; read one shape with block.schema. Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, at most 32 items, 5000 ms budget.

component.description: Only the types this blocks-* component renders, e.g. "blocks-data".

query.description: Words to match against the type, its label and its useWhen notes.

tools.name: block.schema
tools.description: Read the shape of one content block type: the component that renders it, its fields as compact text and as a JSON Schema (required fields are the ones the validator refuses a block without), examples that validate in a blueprint, limits, when to use it and whether it can pass blueprint.validate today. Returns what a blocks-* node’s block prop needs. Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

type.description: A block type from block.list, e.g. "table" or "cta".

tools.name: theme.search
tools.description: Search the Texuli theme library (200+ offline themes) by words, category, collection, mood or tag. Returns the match count and each theme’s metadata: id, name, description, category, collection, mood, tags, contrast level and whether it is dark-first. Limits: input up to 4096 bytes, at most 500 items, 5000 ms budget.

query.description: Words that must all match the id, name, tags, mood, category, collection or description; results are ranked.

mood.description: One mood the theme must have.

limit.description: How many themes to return (1 to 500, default 50).

tools.name: theme.get
tools.description: Read the full token definition of one library theme by id. Returns { theme }: its id, name, description and every light and dark color, radius, font and chart token, ready to compile or apply. Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

id.description: A theme id from theme.search, e.g. "violet" or "enterprise-neutral".

tools.name: theme.preview
tools.description: Preview one library theme in light or dark mode. Returns its summary, the key tokens of that mode (background, foreground, primary, border, radius, font …) and the WCAG 2.x AA contrast report for both modes (aa.pass and issue counts). Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

id.description: A theme id from theme.search, e.g. "violet" or "enterprise-neutral".

mode.description: The mode whose tokens to show (default light); the AA report covers both.

tools.name: ds.validate
tools.description: Validate a design-system document. Set full to run the complete locked-design-system validator, including catalog allow sets, extensions and an optional prototype's component and CSS policy checks. Returns every finding with stable code, severity, area, path and fix hint; the full mode is read-only and does not execute prototype sources. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, at most 16 items, 10000 ms budget.

document.description: A design-system document: format "texuli/design-system", formatVersion 1, id, version, name, and optional sections (extends, color, typography, shape, space, elevation, surface, motion, layout, icons, components, assets, voice, accessibility, variants). texuli://design-system/acme is a full example.

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

variant.description: A variant the document declares under variants (e.g. "high-contrast").

bases.description: Documents for extends: "id@x.y.z", keyed by "id@version". "texuli:<theme>" bases load from the theme library; nothing is fetched.

full.description: Run the full locked-design-system validator. Static only; use a local CLI --render for browser runtime checks.

report.description: Mark this as report-only progress tracking. The operation always returns findings as data; valid still reflects the validator verdict.

strict.description: In full mode, treat warnings as failures in the valid verdict.

catalog.description: Optional spec catalog object; defaults to the bundled Texuli catalog.

extensions.description: Optional host catalog extensions to check and merge.

prototype.description: Optional bounded prototype data: { files: { path: sourceText }, blueprints: { name: blueprint } }. Sources are scanned as text and never executed.

tools.name: ds.compile
tools.description: Compile a design-system document to concrete --tx-* variables per mode and emit one format: compiled JSON, scoped CSS, a Tailwind preset, DTCG or Tokens Studio. Returns valid, the format, its media type, the content as text, the hash and warnings; a refused document returns errors with stable codes instead. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

document.description: A design-system document: format "texuli/design-system", formatVersion 1, id, version, name, and optional sections (extends, color, typography, shape, space, elevation, surface, motion, layout, icons, components, assets, voice, accessibility, variants). texuli://design-system/acme is a full example.

format.description: json (the compiled design system, keys sorted), css (scoped custom properties, light and dark; a single compiled mode goes on the selector), tailwind (a preset), dtcg or tokens-studio (the resolved document as token files: extends merged and the variant applied, so the content matches the reported variant and hash).

selector.description: css only: the scope selector (default [data-tx-ds="<id>"], or :root).

dark.description: css only: dark mode through the .dark class (default), [data-tx-mode="dark"] or prefers-color-scheme.

mode.description: Compile one mode only (default: every mode the document declares).

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

variant.description: A variant the document declares under variants (e.g. "high-contrast").

bases.description: Documents for extends: "id@x.y.z", keyed by "id@version". "texuli:<theme>" bases load from the theme library; nothing is fetched.

tools.name: ds.contrast
tools.description: Compile a design-system document and report every contrast pair the guarantees check, per mode: foreground and background roles, kind (text, ui, focus), ratio, requirement and pass, plus the solver adjustments. Returns valid, the target (AA or AAA), targetMin and the per-mode pairs, or errors with stable codes. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

document.description: A design-system document: format "texuli/design-system", formatVersion 1, id, version, name, and optional sections (extends, color, typography, shape, space, elevation, surface, motion, layout, icons, components, assets, voice, accessibility, variants). texuli://design-system/acme is a full example.

mode.description: Compile one mode only (default: every mode the document declares).

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

variant.description: A variant the document declares under variants (e.g. "high-contrast").

bases.description: Documents for extends: "id@x.y.z", keyed by "id@version". "texuli:<theme>" bases load from the theme library; nothing is fetched.

tools.name: ds.suggest
tools.description: Suggest a starting design-system document from one seed color, up to three brand colors (seed, secondary, accent) or a logo as RGBA pixels (the dominant colors pick the seed). Returns valid, the document, the dominant palette for pixels, the key tokens of each mode and warnings. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, at most 65536 items, 10000 ms budget.

seed.description: A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or a numeric oklch(L C H).

items.description: A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or a numeric oklch(L C H).

colors.description: Up to 3 brand colors: the seed, then the secondary, then the accent.

pixels.description: A logo as RGBA values 0 to 255, 4 per pixel, row by row (at most 65536 values, 128 × 128 pixels); transparent pixels are ignored.

count.description: pixels only: how many dominant colors to report (2 to 12, default 6).

id.description: The id of the resulting document (lowercase words joined by hyphens).

version.description: The semver version of the resulting document (default 1.0.0).

name.description: The display name of the resulting document.

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

tools.name: ds.import
tools.description: Turn what a team already has into a valid design-system document: a brand one-liner ("brand #4f46e5, font Inter, rounded, compact"), a W3C DTCG file, a Tokens Studio file, a flat role palette or a Texuli theme (an object, or a library theme id). Returns valid, the document and warnings for every value it dropped, or errors with stable codes. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

from.description: The source format: brand (text), dtcg, tokens-studio, role-palette (objects or JSON text) or theme (a Theme object or a library theme id).

input.description: The source: the one-liner for brand, a library theme id or Theme for theme, else the token file as an object or JSON text.

id.description: The id of the resulting document (lowercase words joined by hyphens).

version.description: The semver version of the resulting document (default 1.0.0).

name.description: The display name of the resulting document.

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

tools.name: ds.generate
tools.description: Combine a brand brief, token JSON, site CSS, logo pixels and/or a Texuli theme into a validated design-system draft. Returns the document, every reported loss, automatic AA repairs and guarantee results; it never saves or approves the draft. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, at most 65536 items, 10000 ms budget.

brief.description: A short brand brief in plain language (at most 32768 characters).

tokens.description: Token JSON or a JSON string of tokens (at most 262144 characters).

css.description: Site CSS whose custom properties feed the draft (at most 262144 characters).

logoPixels.description: A logo as RGBA pixels; at most 65536 numbers in data.

data.description: RGBA samples packed as numbers, at most 65536 items.

theme.description: A Texuli theme id or theme JSON (at most 262144 characters).

tools.name: ds.allow
tools.description: Build the allow section of a locked design system from the catalog: a preset (minimal, a documented core; all, every component) or the ids you name, each with every variant, size, tone, density, color and state the catalog declares. Narrow it, put it under "allow" and run ds.validate. Returns allow, count, unknown ids and the minimal preset ids. Limits: input up to 32768 bytes, at most 256 items, 10000 ms budget.

preset.description: minimal (a documented core: actions, form controls, text and status, containers, overlays and page layouts) or all (every catalog component). Ignored when components is set.

components.description: Catalog component ids to allow, e.g. ["button", "card", "data-grid"] (find ids with catalog.search).

tools.name: ds.bundle
tools.description: Pack a design-system document with its library sources and release history into one JSON bundle, or unpack a bundle and return those parts. Returns ok, the bundle or the document, allowManifest, librarySources and history; hash mismatches, oversized sources and path-traversing ids are refused with stable codes. Sources are never executed. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, at most 64 items, 10000 ms budget.

bundle.description: A texuli/design-system-bundle object to unpack (format, version 1, document, allowManifest, librarySources, history).

document.description: A texuli/design-system document to pack. Ignored when bundle is set.

librarySources.description: Library component sources as text: { id, version, source, language? }. Ignored when bundle is set.

history.description: Approved versions with changelog entries: { version, contentHash, changelog?, status?, approvedBy?, approvedAt? }. Ignored when bundle is set.

tools.name: ds.diff
tools.description: Compile two design-system documents (before is the baseline) and compare them: every added, removed or changed --tx-* variable per mode, contrast pairs that regressed below the target, changed component defaults and attributes. Returns valid, identical, the summary counts and each list, or errors tagged with their side. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

mode.description: Compile one mode only (default: every mode the document declares).

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

variant.description: A variant the document declares under variants (e.g. "high-contrast").

bases.description: Documents for extends: "id@x.y.z", keyed by "id@version". "texuli:<theme>" bases load from the theme library; nothing is fetched.

tools.name: ds.preview
tools.description: Render a static, deterministic snapshot of a compiled design system: svg (swatches, a button and a card per mode) or html (the review report: swatches, type ramp, component sheet, contrast table and adjustments). Fixed fonts, no time, no scripts; every value escaped. Returns valid, the format, media type, content and hash. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

document.description: A design-system document: format "texuli/design-system", formatVersion 1, id, version, name, and optional sections (extends, color, typography, shape, space, elevation, surface, motion, layout, icons, components, assets, voice, accessibility, variants). texuli://design-system/acme is a full example.

format.description: svg (a compact image, the default) or html (the full review report page).

mode.description: Compile one mode only (default: every mode the document declares).

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

variant.description: A variant the document declares under variants (e.g. "high-contrast").

bases.description: Documents for extends: "id@x.y.z", keyed by "id@version". "texuli:<theme>" bases load from the theme library; nothing is fetched.

tools.name: ds.save
tools.description: Validate a design-system document (as ds.validate does) and write it as two-space JSON to an explicit .json path inside the working directory (traversal, symlinks, dot paths, node_modules, package.json and existing files without overwrite are refused). Anything marked approved is refused (approval-human-only). Local doors only. Returns saved, the path and bytes, or errors with stable codes. Limits: input up to 1048576 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

path.description: Where to write, relative to the working directory (e.g. design-systems/harborline.ds.json): a .json file outside dot directories and node_modules, never package.json.

document.description: A design-system document: format "texuli/design-system", formatVersion 1, id, version, name, and optional sections (extends, color, typography, shape, space, elevation, surface, motion, layout, icons, components, assets, voice, accessibility, variants). texuli://design-system/acme is a full example.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file (default false: an existing file is refused).

dryRun.description: Validate the document and the path, and write nothing.

trust.description: untrusted (agent or user documents, the default) refuses every data: URL; developer accepts capped data: fonts and images.

variant.description: A variant the document declares under variants (e.g. "high-contrast").

bases.description: Documents for extends: "id@x.y.z", keyed by "id@version". "texuli:<theme>" bases load from the theme library; nothing is fetched.

tools.name: deck.run
tools.description: Inspect, lint and convert a Texuli deck on the shared v2 model: capabilities, the JSON Schema, layouts, lint, inspect, from-markdown and to-markdown. Pure compute; returns { result } with the command output (ok, issues, deck, markdown …). Limits: input up to 2100000 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

command.description: capabilities, schema and layouts take nothing; lint, inspect and to-markdown take deck; from-markdown takes markdown.

deck.description: A JSON deck (formatVersion 2) for lint, inspect or to-markdown.

markdown.description: Deck Markdown (front matter, one section per slide) for from-markdown.

tools.name: document.run
tools.description: Create, validate, inspect, patch and convert a Texuli document (spec 0.7.0): capabilities, the JSON Schema, validate, inspect, a bounded RFC 6902 patch (at most 1000 operations), from-markdown, to-markdown and to-blueprint. Returns { result } with the command output; PDF and DOCX are document.export. Limits: input up to 2100000 bytes, at most 1000 items, 10000 ms budget.

command.description: capabilities and schema take nothing; from-markdown takes markdown; every other command takes document.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations for patch (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test).

tier.description: The URL policy tier links and media are checked at (default untrusted).

tools.name: document.export
tools.description: Write a Texuli document as PDF or DOCX bytes with the owned writers, links and media checked at the tier. Returns { result } with ok, mime, byteLength, base64 bytes (no files are written), diagnostics and, for PDF, pageCount. Needs Node. Limits: input up to 2100000 bytes, 30000 ms budget.

tier.description: The URL policy tier links and media are checked at (default untrusted).

instructions: Texuli is a Svelte 5 component library with a closed agent catalog. Tools are group.verb operations: search the component catalog (catalog.search), read manifests (component.get) and worked examples (example.search), list content block types and read the shape and examples of each (block.list, block.schema), validate blueprint drafts (blueprint.validate) and catalog manifests, search, read and preview themes with their WCAG AA report, author design systems (ds.generate returns a draft and its loss, repair and guarantee report; ds.validate, ds.compile, ds.contrast, ds.suggest, ds.import, ds.diff, ds.preview, and blueprint.theme apply one to a blueprint), and run deck and document commands. Every tool states its limits and returns structured JSON; failures are isError results with a stable code (invalid-input, input-too-large, not-found, runtime-unavailable, timeout …), and a refused design system is a valid: false result with the spec's codes and JSON paths. Resources: texuli://catalog, texuli://llms/full, texuli://component/{id}, texuli://docs/{slug}, texuli://theme/{id}, texuli://design-system/{id} and texuli://schema/{name}. Prompts build-ui, theme-blueprint, create-design-system and convert-deck walk through the main jobs. The remote endpoint also lists site.pages, site.read and site.search, which list, read (as Markdown) and search the pages of texuli.com. The 0.8 tool names (catalog, component, validate, example, theme, deck, document) were removed in 0.10.0; a call names the operation to use instead. Nothing reaches the network; the only write is ds.save, on the local server, to an explicit path inside the working directory.
